name: directions-button
title: Directions button
description: Get directions in the maps app people use: Apple Maps on iPhone, Google Maps elsewhere, Waze if they prefer, and the address to copy as a fallback.
docs: Give the destination an address (with its name, so the pin is labelled) or latitude and longitude; a name alone is not enough and disables the button with the reason. Without apps, Apple Maps comes first on iPhone and iPad and Google Maps elsewhere, decided after mount. Waze only drives. The link builders in directions.ts are pure and return null for a place that cannot be used.
